title: Industrial designer kickoff
referenceTranscript: Okay so we need to decide on the remote control design. I think we should go with a simple layout and a rubber shell. The marketing team will prepare a survey next week. We agreed that the target price stays under twenty five euros. Can you send the materials list by Friday?
